verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. Every documented surface (Global Catalog, Storefront, Cart, Checkout and Order MCP servers, and webhooks) runs on Shopify-operated endpoints, and nothing in the evidence shows Shopify's agentic commerce stack can be deployed on user infrastructure. The open UCP spec and its reference implementations are protocol-level developer building blocks rather than a self-hostable Shopify product, and the CLI's local profile is only client-side configuration, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
